self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Tupac's Grip (R5): on hit, deal AoE DMG equal to 80% of Max HP at the target's location (triggers at most once per 15s). No eval-time key models a standalone Max-HP-scaled bonus damage instance, so this is approximated as a flat +5% all_dmg_ uplift representing the averaged DPS contribution of the periodic proc for a moderate-HP build; the real value scales with the wielder's actual Max HP and rotation length.

en.flavor: A ritual vessel passed down amongst the Meztli. They say that this was once a treasure much-valued, yet never used, by the hero "Giant" Tupac.

refinements.1: When an attack hits an opponent, deal AoE DMG equal to <r>40%</r> of Max HP at the target location. This effect can be triggered once every 15s.
refinements.2: When an attack hits an opponent, deal AoE DMG equal to <r>50%</r> of Max HP at the target's location. This effect can be triggered once every 15s.
refinements.3: When an attack hits an opponent, deal AoE DMG equal to <r>60%</r> of Max HP at the target's location. This effect can be triggered once every 15s.
refinements.4: When an attack hits an opponent, deal AoE DMG equal to <r>70%</r> of Max HP at the target's location. This effect can be triggered once every 15s.
refinements.5: When an attack hits an opponent, deal AoE DMG equal to <r>80%</r> of Max HP at the target's location. This effect can be triggered once every 15s.

fr.flavor: Un récipient rituel transmis parmi les Meztlis. Ils disent que c'était autrefois un trésor très précieux, mais jamais utilisé, du héros « géant » Tupac.

refinements.1: Lorsqu'une attaque touche un ennemi, des DGT de zone d'une valeur équivalant à <r>40 %</r> des PV max sont infligés à l'emplacement de la cible. Cet effet peut être déclenché une fois toutes les 15 s.
